display_name: Combined variable of Respiratory Event Index or Apnea Hypopnea Index: (All apneas with no oxygen desaturation threshold used + hypopneas with > 30% flow reduction and with >= 3% oxygen desaturation) / hour of estimated sleep from either type III home sleep apnea test or type I polysomnography
description: Legacy variable created by the PVDOMICS study team by combining the Respiratory Event Index from the PVDOMICS core study protocol (:ahi_score:) with the Respiratory Event Index or Apnea-Hypopnea Index reported from the alternative studies (:ahi_alt:).
